m: A *helping hand* knocks out a wall of the *shed* to **enlarge** it.
A *sheep* sticks its nose in the *dish*, so you slam on a **lid**.
The *king* kneels in the *grass* fiddling with his crown: what is he **doing**?
A *sparrow* with a puffed chest, held in a *left hand* at the *elbow*: the loud one is the **male**.
A *grain stalk* stands upright though a *bent knife* and a *comb* push at it; its *heart* is **steady**.
A *heart* buried under a *tombstone*: it has **forgotten** everything.
A *standing person* counts each *swan* on the lake: a **hundred million** of them!
A *tree* by the *archway* has spikes like a *standing knife*: careful of the **thorn**.
A *helping hand* drops the *bucket* and throws its arms out: it **embraces** you.
*Footsteps* follow a *runner* everywhere he goes: his loyal **disciple**.
A *woman* who acts like a second *mother* to the children: their **nanny**.
A *tree* with leaves flashing in the *sun rays*: a tall **poplar**.
Every *tattoo* on his arm lines up in rows: perfectly **neat**.
Under one *roof*, teams warm up for the big **competition**.
A *runner* stops, cups a *right hand* to his *ear*: something **interesting** is being said.
*Two planks* nailed over a *pit* warp in the rain: they are all **crooked**.
A *bracket* blade with a *slash* of a handle: a **knife**.
In the *shed*, planks of *tree* wood make a place to sleep: a **bed**.
At the end of the *road* a *kneeling man* bows to the guests: he **welcomes** them.
*Icicles* form on the *water*: it turns to **ice**.
A *tiger* prowls round a *scaffold* but the building inside is **empty**.
The *king* jumps over *two planks* on little *legs*: he is **playing**.
A *tree* trunk split in two by an *axe*: it is **divided**.
In the *cave* wall, *trudging feet* have kicked a hole for light: a **window**.
After the *wine jug* is empty, the *sun* rises over a *seedling*: you **wake up**.
A *woman* with a hairpin, holding a broom at home: his **wife**.
Rain runs off the *road* past a *grain stalk* and through a *ribbon*: it **seeps through** everything.
A *shell* coin hidden under the *blanket* by your *elbow*: you'll use it to **purchase** a gift.
A *person* on *two planks*, another *person* on *two planks*, under the *sun*: one steps in to **substitute** for the other.
Under the *roof* you cram bags into the cupboard: **stuff** them **in**.
A *woman* clenches her *right hand* and flexes a *strong arm*: she **strives** hard.
A *standing person* leans against a *tree*: time to **rest**.
A *tiger* crouches on a *small table*, tail twitching: the big cat, **tiger**.
A *helping hand* lifts a flag into the *sun rays*: it **raises** it high.
A *person* walks the *road*: the **route** home.
A *standing person* creeps step by step onto his neighbour's land: he **invades**.
A *door bar* and a *standing knife* on the judge's wall: tools of **punishment**.
A *silk thread* is dipped in *splashing water* and combed with a *comb* of leaves: it turns **green**.
A big *mouth* on long *legs* bossing the little ones: the **elder brother**.
Down the *road* flies a *swift*: **rapid**.
A *big man* pulls his *flowing locks* into a cap: he **covers** his hair.
One *kneeling man* hands a *shell* to another *kneeling man*: they **trade**.
The *twins* cross the line by the *cross* together: they **finish** the race.
A *mouth* calls and just one *sparrow* answers: the **only** one.
Two *curtains* of hills open onto a wide **valley**.
A *person* with a *spoon* greases the *cart*'s **wheel**.
A *shed* where every *cart* unloads its goods: a **warehouse**.
On the *road* a *lid* lies where the cart passed: a **trace** of it.
A man on a *crutch* drops one *drop* of sweat: he works **especially** hard.
On the *podium* a *mouth* shouts "go!" and *legs* start racing: they **compete**.
At the *crossroads*, *soil* on one side and *soil* on the other: shops line the **street**.
A *standing person* taps a *foot* impatiently: "**hurry** up!"
With a *long stride* the road goes on and on: they **extend** it.
*Rain* lashes the beach and the *clam* snaps shut as the ground **shakes**.
An old cart left to rot in the *grass*: **abandoned**.
The first shell of armour hangs under an *archway*: the **first** of the ranks, grade A.
A *standing person* tightens a *leather strap* over broad shoulders: a **great** big hero.
Inside the *shed* two *tree* stalks hang to dry: **hemp**.
Three *poles* side by side, bending a little: three streams that make a **river**.
The *sun* is skewered by a *pole* from heaven to earth: the gods **state** their will.
A *claw* tugs gently at a *silk thread*: **slow**, so it won't snap.
Under *water drops*, a *person* on *two planks* and another *person* on *two planks* lie **hidden** from the *sun*.
A *person* ducks behind the *gate*: he **dodges** the ball.
A *sparrow* with an open *mouth* sings in the market: "**sell**, sell!"
A *campfire* flame hung on a *nail*: a **lamp**.
*Gold coins* buy a sliver of metal with a *cross*-shaped eye: a **needle**.
A *helping hand* lays down the *axe*, and the *mouth* speaks instead: that is **wise**.
*Silk thread* runs past *trudging feet* to every *mouth* in town: a **network**.
A *helping hand* braces against the *foundation*: it **resists** the push.
A *sapling* cut with a *slide* shows red wood inside: **vermilion**.
*Soil* kicked by an *elbow* and an *arrow* flies through it: clouds of **dust**.
A *helping hand* wraps a *blanket* around a baby *cobra*: it **holds** it close.
A *cross*-braced frame, a *bean*-shaped body and a *branch* to beat it: a **drum**.
You push a young *tree* into the ground next to a *cross* marker: you **plant** it.
A *silk thread* tied to a *cross* and a *root hook*: nothing mixed in, **pure** silk.
*Trudging feet* under a wide *summer hat*: it is **summer**.
A *blade edge* pressed on the *heart*: you grit your teeth and **endure** it.
An *awning* over a *shell*: like the top of a book, a **page**.
A *tree* stands tall above burning *embers*: it survived the fire, a **hero**.
*Bamboo* poles, a *workbench* and a *sail* for the roof: they **build** a hut.
A *helping hand* swings an *axe* and the stick **breaks**.
A *hillside* under the *sky*, guarded by soldiers with *horns* on their helmets: the old state of **Zheng**.
An *archway* of shell with a *person*-shaped foot poking out: a **shell**.
*Horns* of incense, a *wine jug* raised with a *thumb*: you toast your elders in **respect**.
A *mouth* sings under the open *sky* of the south: the old land of **Wu**.
A *grain stalk* tied with a silk *ribbon*, bending in the breeze: how **graceful**.
*Water drops*, *sun* and *twins* splashing together: everything gets **mixed**.
An *open crate* holds the scrolls of the king's **official**.
A *sparrow* lifts one *fang*-shaped wing as it lands: so **elegant**.
A *helping hand* shakes the *clam* until it opens: it **shakes**.
A *crowbar* stirs *water drops* full of colour from a *tree* bark: you **dye** the cloth.
A *swarm* of bees, a *halberd* raised and a *dish* piled high: the kingdom is **flourishing**.
A *woman* slams her *right hand* on the table, her *heart* full of **anger**.
*Dancing feet* spin under a swirl of ribbons: **dance**.
A *fence*, a *mouth* and a *shell*: all **round**.
A *helping hand* builds a *tower*: what are they **doing** now?
A *prowling dog* bites the *king*: it must be **mad**.
A *helping hand* clears the *hurdle* in the *sun*: it **handles** the problem.
A *woman* gives birth to a *seedling* of a child: it takes the family **surname**.
A *skeleton* with *twin blades*: everything it touches is **destroyed**.
A *grain stalk* is cut and the stubble burnt on a *campfire*: **autumn**.
A gardener on a *podium* of *soil* calls through her *mouth* to her helpers: they **cultivate** the seedlings.
On the *road* you follow a trail of *rice* grains into the woods and get **lost**.
A *small speech bubble* swears an oath before a *swarm* of soldiers with a *halberd*: he is **sincere**.
Under the *roof* the *watcher* looks out at *grass* stretching far: so **wide**.
Under the *roof* of the night sky, the stars hang like coats on a *coat stand*: the **universe**.
A *prowling dog* snatches a *child*'s *dish*: how **fierce**.
A *helping hand* lays a *fishing net* on the *soil*, an *elbow* smoothing it: neatly **arranged**.
A *mother* in a *slanted cap* shakes the *tree*: down fall the **plums**.
A *war club* swings and the vase is **destroyed**.
A *standing person* slides a *skewer* through the meat and **stretches** out an arm.
A *hand* rubs a stalk of *hemp* until it frays: **rub**.
The *sun* and the *moon* drink from one *dish*: they swear an **alliance**.
A long *plank* across the top of the *tree*: the very **end** of the branch.
A *bent wire* and a *slash*: an old way of writing "it **is**".
A bird with *spread wings* flies away and leaves my *heart* **sad**.
A *helping hand* claps and the *white dove* flutters up: you **clap**.
A *plank* on top, a *fish hook* below: a strong working **man** stands straight.
A *runner* flashes past like *scissors* through cloth: he **surpasses** them all (today: the surname Zhao).
A *stone* hits the *gong*: clang! So **hard**.
A *seedling top* pushes up under *trudging feet*: fields of **wheat**.
By the *grass* a *helping hand* lifts a *lid* from a *split log* full of *crumbs*: the surname **Jiang**.
A *helping hand* reaches into a *tree* where three *mouths* of baby birds cry: it **grasps** the nest.
An *ear* hears a shout across the *hillside*: "**ye**!", a sound used in names like 耶稣 Jesus.
A *stepladder* is set across the *hillside* path: the way is **blocked**.
A *small speech bubble* says "deal" and a *nail* pins the note: you **book** it.
A *claw* plucks fruit from a *tree*, painted with *bristles*: full of **colour**.
A *helping hand* reaches into the *pit* and **pulls out** a card.
Two *cow heads* on long *legs*, two more *legs*, and a gift of a *shell*: they **praise** the winner.
A *ghost* hides among stalks of *hemp*: a **devil**.
A *knife* slices the *silk thread* behind the *curtains* into **numerous** pieces.
*Water drops* trace the banks: you walk **along** the river.
A *mouth* at the *cliff* edge, a *halberd* raised, a *covered mouth* uncovered: everyone **shouts**.
On the *road* he cuts the *leather strap* and runs: he **disobeys** orders.
A *woman* waters a *sapling*: the little one is her **younger sister**.
*Water drops* crash over a *good meal* on the beach: a **wave**.
*Water drops* from every side flow into an *open crate*: they **converge**.
A *slide* of metal stamped and wrapped in a *towel*: a **coin**.
*Three planks* of grain racks pierced by one *pole*: the harvest is **abundant**.
*Grass* soaked in a *dish* turns the water **blue**: indigo dye.
A *skeleton* painted with *red lacquer*: a very **special** museum piece.
A *dog* lies down by the *cross* of the shrine: it **offers** its loyalty.
Planks of *tree* wood on four legs: a **table**.
A *mouth* cheers from the *podium* and a *helping hand* waves: "we won **la**!"
A *drop* of rain rolls down a curved clay **tile**.
*Grass* round a *sapling* with leaves like little *horns*: the weed **goosefoot**.
A *helping hand* grabs a *claw* stuck in the trap: it **helps** pull it out.
A *small speech bubble* in one language becomes another: you **translate**.
A *big man* grabs the prize with his *thumb* and fingers: he **seizes** it.
*Water drops* boil and *steam* rises: **steam**.
